records.part: Upgrades and modifications to existing Drone Amplified–integrated Freefly Alta X aircraft, including ignition hardware, onboard electronics, wiring architecture, software integrations, and ground control configuration
records.reason: Drone Amplified is the sole designer, integrator, and manufacturer of the specialized systems installed on these aircraft. Because these components are custom-designed and proprietary to Drone Amplified, no other vendor can provide compatible parts, service, or upgrades.
